findings.description: The reports_archive bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, so objects are stored with SSE-S3 default behavior at best and no KMS-managed key, leaving report data unencrypted under a customer-controlled key.

findings.issue_category: disabled versioning and no lifecycle protection
findings.description: versioning is not enabled on reports_archive, so overwritten or deleted report objects cannot be recovered and ransomware-style deletion is destructive.
No aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block is attached to reports_archive, so the bucket can be made public via ACLs or bucket policy and lacks the account-level guardrail.
The ledger_exports bucket containing financial ledger data has no server_side_encryption_configuration, so ledger exports are not encrypted with a managed KMS key.
versioning is not enabled on ledger_exports, allowing irreversible overwrite or deletion of financial export data.
model_artifacts stores ML model artifacts without server_side_encryption_configuration, so model data is not encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key.
ops_runbooks has no server_side_encryption_configuration, leaving operational runbooks that may contain credentials and internal procedures stored without a KMS-managed key.

findings.issue_category: log bucket writable by log delivery only
findings.description: audit_trail uses acl = "log-delivery-write", which grants the S3 log delivery group write and read-acp permissions on the bucket; this is the intended setting for a log target but combines with the audit_trail_key KMS key and no public access block, so the audit bucket's access control depends solely on that ACL.
audit_trail, which receives server access logs including possibly sensitive request metadata, has no aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block preventing public exposure.

reports_seed_object uploads vendor-roster.xlsx into reports_archive with no server_side_encryption or kms_key_id attribute, so the seeded object is stored under default encryption rather than a customer-managed key.
force_destroy = true on reports_archive allows terraform destroy to delete the bucket and all report objects without error, removing a recovery safeguard against destructive operations.
force_destroy = true on ledger_exports permits deletion of all financial ledger objects on destroy, weakening data retention controls.
force_destroy = true on model_artifacts allows the model artifact bucket and its contents to be destroyed without safeguard.
force_destroy = true on ops_runbooks permits deletion of runbooks and any embedded secrets during a destroy.
force_destroy = true on the audit_trail bucket allows the audit log target to be destroyed, deleting the record of access to all other buckets and undermining auditability.
